summary: Planned office/laboratory block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a flat 130 ft height limit; residential uses are not permitted here; no design review approval or construction start found.

facts.value: Non-Retail Sales/Services (office) and Laboratory/Life Science uses permitted; Residential Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)
flat 130 ft max per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3

One or more of Blocks 2, 3, 11, 12 or 15 must be deed-restricted for Life Science/Laboratory uses under the Development Agreement's Phasing Plan (as adopted; a July 2022 Planning Commission resolution separately removed an earlier, block-specific 130,000 sq ft life-science requirement tied to Block 15 -- see that record)
Not listed among the six Phase 1 blocks (2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) named in the 2024 annual compliance report
